description: AuditLogger can record authentication success and failure events
steps: Call log_auth_success with user_id and ip_address
Verify events are written to log file

description: AuditLogger can record guardrail block and warning events
steps: Call log_guardrail_block with content_preview and reason

description: AuditLogger can record rate limit exceeded events
steps: Call log_rate_limit_exceeded with limit_type and endpoint
Verify event is logged with risk_level=MEDIUM

description: AuditLogger provides get_stats for event counting
steps: Log multiple events of different types
Verify counts are returned for all event types
Log events from multiple threads concurrently
